rationale: X independently nails four of the most severe ground-truth findings with near-exact mechanisms and line numbers: the text-encoder-tp GroupCoordinator crash, Ring attention silently ignoring packed padding boundaries, the encoder's warn-instead-of-raise on missing weights, and unbounded upload sizes. Y produces detailed, evidence-heavy findings but misses every one of the reviewers' actual bugs (the crash, the ring/packing corruption, the loaded.add() bug, the validation gaps), instead surfacing unverified tangential concerns (FA4 reachability, cross-pipeline video path ambiguity) with two near-duplicate 'major' findings padding its count. X's verdict and severity ranking also track the real outcome (blocking correctness/crash bugs) far better than Y's softer follow-up framing.
